description: The ready WakeHuBERT 'computer' model that ovos-ww-plugin-wakeforge ships as its default wake-word engine, at the model's own calibrated default threshold (0.99).
notes: Plugin default config: the ready model named in 'model', fetched from OpenVoiceOS/wakehubert-wakewords at the revision the plugin pins; threshold, smoothing and debounce come from the model's own metadata. Training data per the model card: TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-computer (CC BY 4.0).
